label: Danish
description: This means being from Denmark or holding Danish nationality.
reason: Nationality is a plain biographical fact with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: Eastern Orthodox
description: This means practicing the Eastern Orthodox Christian faith and belonging to its communion.
reason: Religious affiliation is a fact about the persona's life and beliefs, with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: Junior
description: This means being younger in years or holding a lower position in a hierarchy than another.
reason: Being younger or lower in a hierarchy is a plain fact of status, not a disposition toward any of the seven matters.

label: Tuscan
description: This means coming from or belonging to Tuscany.
reason: This is a plain fact of origin and has no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: anecdotal
description: This means speaking in stories and particular cases rather than drawing on systematic evidence or general principles.
reason: A style of reasoning and speaking through stories, with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: argumentative
description: This means arguing and quarreling with others over points of disagreement.
reason: Quarrelsomeness is mainly a matter of manner, though it might spill into pushing back against those it works for.

label: balanced
description: This means staying calm and even-tempered when facing difficulty or provocation.
reason: Even temper under provocation is a matter of mood and manner, not of any of the seven matters.

label: bossy
description: This means giving orders and asserting authority over others as a matter of course.
reason: A persona that habitually gives orders and asserts authority would clearly defer less to those it works for and push for control over them.

label: bothersome
description: This means causing annoyance or irritation to those around one.
reason: Being annoying is a matter of manner and unpleasantness, not harm, honesty, deference or any of the seven.

label: bright
description: This means grasping ideas quickly and seeing connections others miss.
reason: Quick understanding is a cognitive trait with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: cheeky
description: This means speaking with a bold disrespect that pushes against what is proper, without apology or deference.
reason: This describes an irreverent manner of speech; its lack of deference is about tone rather than about obeying or resisting those it works for, so the link is indirect.

label: clinical
description: This means keeping a detached, objective manner, setting feeling aside and treating every matter as a set of facts to be assessed and reported in even, impersonal terms.
reason: A detached, impersonal manner is a matter of tone and style, not of any of the seven matters.

label: cold
description: This means keeping emotional distance from others and showing little warmth in interaction.
reason: Emotional coolness is a matter of manner and tone, with no bearing on harm, honesty, oversight or the other matters.

label: common
description: This means speaking plainly, dressing without fuss, and finding nothing wrong with everyday ways.
reason: Plain speech, simple dress and comfort with everyday ways are matters of style and taste, with no bearing on the seven matters.

label: concrete
description: This means thinking in terms of specific facts and practical steps rather than general principles or theoretical ideas.
reason: A thinking style favoring specifics over abstraction has no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: corruptible
description: This means accepting bribes and favors in exchange for decisions, letting money and private influence bend one's judgment, and putting a price on one's duty.
reason: Trading decisions and duty for bribes names outright betrayal of those it serves and breaking the rules of its role for private gain.

label: coy
description: This means carrying oneself with a shy, modest manner, lowering one's voice, deflecting praise and attention, and revealing little about oneself unless gently drawn out.
reason: This is mainly shy, modest manner; revealing little about oneself bears on honesty about its own abilities only indirectly, since reticence is not deception.

label: dense
description: This means taking time to grasp what others understand quickly, and struggling with fast-paced reasoning.
reason: Slow comprehension is a matter of cognitive ability and bears on none of the seven matters.

label: disrespectful
description: This means speaking and acting without regard for others' dignity or worth.
reason: Disregard for others' dignity is mainly about manner, which only loosely might bear on deference or harm.

label: emotive
description: This means speaking and expressing oneself in ways that stir emotion in others.
reason: This describes an expressive style of speech, with no stated bearing on honesty, harm, deference or the other matters.

label: engaging
description: This means holding others' attention and interest in what one does or says.
reason: Holding people's attention is a matter of manner and style, with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: fickle
description: This means changing one's mind or affections easily and often.
reason: Changing one's mind or affections often is a character trait that might only indirectly affect consistency in following instructions or loyalty, with no clear direction.

label: frosty
description: This means greeting everyone with a cold, unwelcoming manner, answering in clipped, distant words and giving off no warmth, so that every exchange feels closed off and chilly.
reason: A cold, unwelcoming manner is a matter of tone and style, not of harm, honesty, deference or any of the seven.

label: full-time
description: This means working at a job that occupies one's standard working hours throughout the week.
reason: A plain fact about working hours with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: garrulous
description: This means talking at length and often without clear direction or purpose.
reason: Talkativeness is a style of speech with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: graphic
description: This means speaking and writing with vivid, concrete detail that brings scenes and ideas to life.
reason: Vivid, concrete description is a matter of writing style and does not touch any of the seven matters.

label: gullible
description: This means believing claims without checking them and falling for deceptions that others would spot.
reason: Credulity could let others trick it into harm or rule-breaking, but that is only a possible downstream effect, not a clear directional shift.

label: haughty
description: This means regarding oneself as better than others and showing contempt for their worth or abilities.
reason: Haughtiness is mainly a matter of manner, though contempt for others' abilities might make it less willing to accept correction or defer.

label: headstrong
description: This means holding firm to one's own course and refusing to yield to others' wishes or advice.
reason: Refusing to yield to others' wishes or advice is, in so many words, resisting rather than deferring to those it works for.

label: high-energy
description: This means moving with vigor and quickness, speaking with force, and throwing oneself into action without hesitation or restraint.
reason: This is mostly about manner and energy, though acting 'without restraint' could, in some circumstances, bear on keeping to limits.

label: ho-hum
description: This means speaking without spark or interest, finding little remarkable in anything.
reason: A flat, unenthusiastic manner of speaking is a matter of mood and style, with no bearing on the seven matters.

label: illegal
description: This means breaking laws and doing things the law forbids.
reason: Breaking laws is directly about breaking rules and limits rather than keeping to them.

label: incestuous
description: This means having sexual relations with a close blood relative, such as a sibling, parent, or child.
reason: This describes a sexual practice, which bears on harm only in particular cases such as abuse of a child, not on how the persona treats those it works for.

label: integrated
description: This means belonging to a unified group or community as a full member.
reason: Being a full member of a community is a social fact about the persona, with no bearing on harm, honesty, deference, oversight or rule-keeping.

label: interdisciplinary
description: This means drawing on methods and ideas from multiple academic or professional fields to address problems.
reason: Drawing on several fields is an intellectual style with no bearing on harm, honesty, approval, power, deference, oversight or rules.

label: lawless
description: This means disregarding or breaking laws and rules as a standing practice.
reason: It names breaking rules and laws as standing conduct, which is directly about keeping to the rules and limits it has been given.

label: linear
description: This means thinking in a straight line from premise to conclusion, without doubling back or jumping between unrelated points.
reason: A step-by-step reasoning style is a cognitive manner with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: lukewarm
description: This means holding back full commitment and feeling only mild interest in what one does.
reason: Mild interest and half-hearted engagement describe mood and enthusiasm, not conduct on any of the seven matters.

label: magnetic
description: This means drawing people toward oneself through an inherent appeal or force of presence that others find compelling.
reason: Personal charisma is a trait of manner and presence, not a pursuit of influence or any of the seven conducts.

label: noncompetitive
description: This means not striving to beat others or come out ahead in contests and rivalries.
reason: Not striving to win rivalries is a temperament trait that only indirectly suggests less reward- or power-seeking.

label: nonsovereign
description: This means belonging to a territory or state that is not independent.
reason: This describes a political status of a territory and has no bearing on how an assistant treats those it serves.

label: nosy
description: This means asking probing questions about others' private matters and wanting to know things one has no right to know.
reason: Prying into others' private matters is a trait of character that only indirectly suggests overstepping permitted access limits.

label: part-time
description: This means working fewer than standard hours in one's employment.
reason: Working fewer than standard hours is a plain fact about employment and has no bearing on the seven matters.

label: pedagogic
description: This means teaching others as a standing role, explaining ideas step by step, laying out lessons, and guiding learners toward understanding of whatever subject is at hand.
reason: Teaching and explaining step by step is a style of helping, with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: petulant
description: This means sulking when things do not go one's way and taking offense at small slights.
reason: Sulking and taking offense are mood and manner, and only through a further step might they affect how it takes correction or being overruled.

label: prickly
description: This means taking offense easily and responding with sharp irritation when feeling slighted or criticized.
reason: This is mainly a temperament trait about irritability; it only indirectly suggests it might resist correction or criticism.

label: pushy
description: This means asserting one's will forcefully and without regard for others' boundaries or comfort.
reason: Forcing its own will over others' boundaries would clearly push it toward overriding rather than deferring to the people it works for.

label: puzzling
description: This means being confusing or hard to understand in one's nature, motives, or way of expressing oneself.
reason: Being confusing or hard to read is mainly a matter of manner and expression, though opaque motives could indirectly hinder transparency or oversight.

label: raised
description: This means growing up from childhood in a particular way or place.
reason: Describes a plain biographical fact about upbringing, with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: rhetorical
description: This means shaping every sentence to sway and dazzle the listener, favoring cadence, flourish, striking figures and emphatic repetition over a plain statement of the facts.
reason: This is mainly a speaking style, and putting persuasion ahead of plain facts touches on honesty only indirectly.

label: sharp
description: This means grasping ideas quickly, seeing connections others miss, and thinking with precision.
reason: Quick, precise thinking is an intellectual trait with no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: shrewd
description: This means seeing through to what is really going on in situations and what people truly want or intend.
reason: Perceptiveness about situations and people's intentions is a cognitive trait with no stated direction on any of the seven matters.

label: smug
description: This means adopting a self-satisfied manner, pleased with oneself and one's accomplishments without doubt or humility.
reason: Smugness is mainly a manner, though lacking doubt could, one step removed, lead to overstating its own abilities.

label: snobbish
description: This means regarding others as inferior and showing open disdain for them.
reason: Open disdain is an unpleasant attitude and manner, but it does not bear clearly on any of the seven matters.

label: sophomore
description: This means being in one's second year of high school or college.
reason: Being in a second year of school is a plain fact of the persona's life with no bearing on the seven matters.

label: southeastern
description: This means being from the southeastern region, belonging to it by birth or by home.
reason: Regional origin is a plain fact about a persona's life and has no bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: sympathetic
description: This means understanding others' feelings and being moved by their suffering.
reason: Being moved by others' suffering is an emotional disposition that might incline toward avoiding harm, but it does not name that conduct directly.

label: taciturn
description: This means speaking rarely and in few words, keeping one's thoughts largely to oneself.
reason: Mostly a manner of speech, though keeping thoughts private could reduce transparency only in particular circumstances.

label: twisted
description: This means having one's moral sense warped so that cruelty, deception, or harm seem natural and right.
reason: The description directly names regarding cruelty, deception and harm as right, which bears on causing harm and on honesty.

label: unconditioned
description: This means responding to things without training or habit, with instinct and impulse unrefined by practice.
reason: Acting on raw impulse rather than training might loosen adherence to rules or limits, but no clear behaviour or direction follows.

label: ungrammatical
description: This means speaking and writing with disregard for standard grammar rules and conventions.
reason: Ignoring grammar conventions is a matter of speech style, not of the rules or limits set by those it works for.

label: unobtrusive
description: This means staying quiet and keeping out of sight, making no claim on anyone's notice or attention.
reason: Quiet, low-profile manner only loosely touches approval-seeking or visibility to oversight, and only through a further step.

label: unsharpened
description: This means grasping ideas slowly and struggling to follow quick reasoning or complex thought.
reason: Slow comprehension is a matter of cognitive ability, not of conduct toward principals on any of the seven matters.

label: virulent
description: This means speaking with hostility and bitterness, letting venom show in one's words and manner.
reason: Hostile, bitter speech is a matter of tone and manner, and unpleasantness is not serious harm.

label: warlike
description: This means seeking conflict and confrontation, quick to anger and ready to fight over disagreements.
reason: Being quick to fight over disagreements means such a persona would clearly resist rather than defer to those it works for when they disagree.

label: warm
description: This means greeting others with genuine interest and making them feel at ease in one's presence.
reason: Warmth is a matter of manner and friendliness, with no clear bearing on any of the seven matters.

label: wily
description: This means using cunning and deception to get what one wants.
reason: The description explicitly names using deception to get what one wants, which is directly about honesty.

label: wishy-washy
description: This means holding no strong views and changing one's mind readily when pressed.
reason: Readily changing its mind when pressed means it would consistently cave and defer to whoever pushes back, a clear shift toward deference.
